next_test: Check the difficult fit variant and test ordinary use according to the stated instructions.
stop_rule: Do not sell misleading sizes, invent wash instructions or replace mandatory labels with a care card.
automation: Produce charts/inserts from approved measurements and version the source data.
human_needed: Measure physical samples and approve accurate use instructions.

decision: What delivery promise and parcel price can be used?
default: Use measured packed format and observed supplier plus carrier timing, with a justified buffer.
options: ["Self-dispatch tracked large letter if it qualifies", "Self-dispatch tracked small parcel", "Verified supplier direct dispatch"]
evidence: ["https://www.royalmail.com/sites/royalmail.com/files/2026-09/online-price-guide-october-2026-v1-ta.pdf", "https://www.royalmail.com/prices2026", "https://www.gov.uk/online-and-distance-selling-for-businesses/distance-selling"]
metric: Packed size/weight, applicable tariff date, order-to-dispatch and dispatch-to-delivery
next_test: Rehearse tracked dispatch and log arrival condition; plan using 5 October tariffs for a launch after that date.
stop_rule: Do not offer an unsupported fast-delivery claim or charge an obsolete parcel rate.
automation: Calculate total promised time and flag tariff expiry or missing tracking.
human_needed: Authorise recipient/address and physical dispatch; approve delivery wording.

decision: When should stock move to a 3PL?
default: Self-pack the tiny pilot; retain public 3PL costs as future comparison evidence.
options: ["Self-pack", "iON public starter rates subject to full terms", "Hubd quote after authorised outreach", "Another complete quote"]
evidence: ["https://ionpackaging.co.uk/pricing/", "https://www.hubd.co.uk/pricing/"]
metric: All-in 3PL cost including goods-in, storage, pack, shipping, returns, inserts and stock withdrawal versus saved time/service benefit
next_test: At repeat demand, compare a full rate card against measured self-pack minutes and actual carrier cost.
stop_rule: Do not treat headline pick/pack as a delivered-order price or agree a monthly commitment unsupported by volume.
automation: Estimate costs at 10, 50 and 100 monthly orders without opening accounts.
human_needed: Authorise quote requests, confirm terms and decide whether service benefit pays for the difference.

decision: How should consumer returns be handled?
default: Use the retailer's lawful consumer policy and funded return process, separately from supplier B2B terms.
options: ["Retailer receives/inspects returns", "Agreed 3PL return service", "Supplier route only where it meets consumer obligations"]
evidence: ["https://www.gov.uk/accepting-returns-and-giving-refunds", "https://www.gov.uk/online-and-distance-selling-for-businesses/distance-selling"]
metric: Customer refund timing, standard delivery refund, return cost, resale condition and reserve cash
next_test: Draft cancellation/defect flow and rehearse receipt, inspection and refund bookkeeping.
stop_rule: Do not launch with no lawful contact/returns arrangement or a blanket no-refunds policy.
automation: Track statutory deadlines, return reasons and reserve balances.
human_needed: Choose compliant business correspondence/return arrangements; no personal home address is published in this research.

decision: What claims can repacked goods carry?
default: Preserve warnings/identifiers and describe only documented inspection or packing actions.
options: ["Inspected and repacked where true", "Specific substantiated packaging environmental claim", "Own-brand role assessment before relabelling"]
evidence: ["https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/general-product-safety-regulations-2005/general-product-safety-regulations-2005-great-britain", "https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/green-claims-code-making-environmental-claims/environmental-claims-on-goods-and-services"]
metric: Claim-to-evidence links, required label visibility and correct producer role
next_test: Review insert, pack label and product copy against records for the exact SKU.
stop_rule: Remove unsupported refurbished, UK-made, authorised, safety, medical or whole-product sustainability claims.
automation: Flag unsupported claims and preserve approved label/insert versions.
human_needed: Approve truth and scope of claims and any role change caused by relabelling.

decision: Can the supplier reproduce the accepted product?
default: Buy only the smallest affordable repeat batch after authorisation and inspect every unit.
options: ["Same SKU repeat passes", "Supplier remedy with documented retest", "Stop supplier/SKU"]
evidence: ["https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/general-product-safety-regulations-2005/general-product-safety-regulations-2005-great-britain", "sourcing-packaging.md: proposed reference sample and lot register"]
metric: Accepted units, substitutions, defects, batch identity and cost per usable unit
next_test: Compare repeat units with retained reference; record supplier invoice, batch and onward customer order.
stop_rule: Stop on essential defects, undocumented substitution, traceability failure or negative contribution.
automation: Link supplier lots to orders and recalculate accepted-unit cost.
human_needed: Inspect physical units; authorise remedial action, sale or disposal.
